body.title: Construct completed candidates from real paired host evidence
body.summary: Integrate bounded native diagnostics and host facts into the existing serial control/restricted runner. Build actual effective inventory, all required per-check bases and ordered ACK/cancel trace; emit completed candidate only when independently supported, replacing the unreachable success branch.
acceptanceChecks: Complete scripted native/host evidence reaches completed plus candidate, and installed evidence inspection accepts its v2 shape.
Raw canary silence is unchanged; candidate denials require bound policy/native/source facts and working labelled controls, never flags or model claims alone.
Every leak/missing fact yields failed/unsupported without candidate. Operator cancellation cannot count as successful internal post-ACK cancellation.
Keep shared provider lane, aggregate128K/300sec/8MiB including diagnostic files; at most one control then one restricted subprocess, actual drain, no retry and unknown usage null.

tests.name: Complete paired host evidence emits a completed Claude v2 candidate and qualifies through installed authority
Internal post-ACK cancellation qualifies only after actual process drain while operator cancellation stays cancelled
